handback.summary: Commits credit the co-author setting, and agent prompts follow the settings' owner docs, paths, test runner, caps and house rules.

criteria.796.1: `dokima/settings.py` env mode adds `CO_AUTHOR`; `agent.yml` push and `wiki.yml` sync add the trailer only when it is set.
criteria.796.2: `agent.yml` runtime copy reads `OWNER_DOCS` from the settings and copies that file and its linked topic files; a missing one only warns.
criteria.796.3: `dokima/prompt.py` `build()` puts the owner docs file in place of every AGENTS.md in the shipped prompt.
criteria.796.4: `dokima/prompt.py` `build()` writes the protected paths into the worker's never-edit line.
criteria.796.5: `dokima/prompt.py` `runner_line()` draws the planner's runner line from the test commands, folder and tag.
criteria.796.6: `dokima/prompt.py` `caps_table()` writes each cap from the caps setting into its table row.
criteria.796.7: `agent.yml` copies main's prompt addition files into the runtime and appends `dokima.prompt house` output after the whole prompt.
criteria.796.8: `dokima/prompt.py` `for_role()` drops other roles' `## <role>` sections, keeping shared text and the role's own.
criteria.796.9: `dokima/defaults.yaml` ships `co_author` empty, so no trailer is written without a setting.
criteria.796.10: New `.dokima/settings.yaml` holds the owner's co-author line for this repo.

raises.label: Owner docs elsewhere
raises.text: Owner's words checks still read only AGENTS.md, so quotes from a renamed owner docs file are never found.
raises.evidence: `dokima/agent_next.py:13` reads `AGENTS.md`; `dokima/agent_checks.py:235` accepts only `AGENTS.md` as a source.
